messages:
jess: Heads-up — finalizing the benchmark narrative for launch. Need two compact chart variants (latency slices + tokens->$) + webinar ask + inbound routing plan. Quick thread to lock owners?

mike: For charts I'd do: 1) tokens -> $ (sparkline small multiples by model/quant) 2) stacked latency components (queue, compute, tail) with a callout for cache hits. Keep both readable at 600x300.

anita: Love that. Draft two headline options too: 'Speed where it matters' vs 'Lower token costs, same quality'. We can A/B test in webinar CTAs.

maria: Design constraints noted. Can we pick color palette that maps to cost(delta) (greens) and latency (blues)? I'll drop a figma frame — https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/bench-frames — will add 2 variants.

sam: Pushed a quick dataset sample to /shared/bench; sketch numbers: median latency 80ms, tail 95th 420ms, token cost $0.003 per 1k tokens baseline, optimized path $0.0009. SQL to reproduce:```SELECT model, percentile_latency(p90) as p90, avg_cost_per_1k FROM bench_runs WHERE slice='chat' AND date > '2026-03-01';``` Use quantized variants for the cost line.

own: For inbound routing — recommend 2 funnels from the webinar: SMB (trial flow) vs Enterprise (contact AE + dedicated demo). Use UTM=webinar-smb / webinar-enterprise. Capture model+load pattern in form.

jess: Webinar structure idea: 10m product framing, 20m demo (live perf dashboard + 2 model variants), 20m deep-dive on economics & best practices, 10m q&a. Need someone to run live perf dashboard (Sam?) and someone to narrate cost breakdown (Mike).

mike: I can do cost breakdown + short script for the demo. Suggest we pre-record the heavy perf run to avoid live flakiness and have a 2min live smoke check.

launch-bot: Reminder: dry run scheduled in 48h — add owners to the calendar event or it gets auto-cancelled. :rotating_light:

anita: Owners & deadlines: Maria — chart frames by EOD tomorrow. Sam — final data table + pre-record by tomorrow noon. Mike — cost script by EOD. Jess — webinar outline + landing page copy by EOD. Owen — UTM + funnel wiring by EOD. If anyone needs more time shout here. :thumbsup:

maria: On it — will upload figma frames and export PNGs sized for blog and slide.

sam: Will also include a small CSV for marketing to generate the tokens->$ sparkline.

jess: Perfect. If no major objections I'll thread this into the launch plan doc and tag owners. Thanks all! :rocket:
